item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 20/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to Guangdong tomorrow. An easterly airstream will reach the coastal areas of Guangdong during the day tomorrow. With the strengthening of an anticyclone aloft during the weekend and early next week, showers will ease off and the weather will be brighter over the coastal areas of southern China. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong midweek next week.
